name: Sexual Assault
overview: Scripture reveals the reality of violence and corruption in a fallen world, as seen in Genesis 6:11 where the earth is described as filled with violence. The account of Dinah in Genesis 34:1 illustrates the vulnerability and consequences surrounding sexual assault. The Psalms affirm God's righteous judgment against those who love violence (Psalm 11:5) and His protection and refuge for the oppressed (Psalm 9:9), promising to bring down the oppressors and save the needy, especially children (Psalm 72:4). Believers are reminded to trust in God's justice amidst such brokenness (Psalm 55:23).
